title: minecraft mob path
description: Path Mod lets players choose from unique mob-inspired paths, each with its own strengths, weaknesses, passive abilities, active skills, and mob interactions. Become a powerful Warden with Sonic Boom, command Wither Skeleton minions and many more
body:
**use /path (player name) path to choose a path or just /path path to give yourself one**

💀 Wither: +10 Hearts, lava immunity, attacks inflict Wither III. Right-click with an empty hand to fire explosive Wither Skulls, or with a Stone Sword to summon friendly Wither Skeleton minions that fight your enemies. Withers ignore you.
🐉 Dragon: Right-click with an empty hand to unleash an explosive Dragon's Breath attack.
🔮 Enderman: +10 Hearts, no Ender Pearl damage, receives the Infinity Pearl, and Endermen stay neutral. Water and rain damage you.
👁️ Elder Guardian: +10 Hearts, underwater breathing, Dolphin's Grace in water, and Shift + Empty Hand fires a Guardian Laser. Guardians remain friendly.
🔊 Warden: +20 Hearts, permanent Strength II and Blindness I. Right-click with an empty hand to unleash a Sonic Boom (uses Echo Shards). Wardens ignore you.
🤖 Iron Golem: +10 Hearts, complete fall damage immunity, but sinks faster in water.
🦇 Bat: Permanent flight, night vision in darkness, sunlight blindness, and right-click while holding an ore item to detect nearby matching ores.
🔥 Blaze: +5 Hearts, fire immunity, Slow Falling, and right-click with an empty hand to shoot Blaze Fireballs. Water and rain are harmful.
🐚 Shulker: +10 Armor and right-click with an empty hand to fire homing Shulker Bullets.
🪓 Piglin Brute: +10 Hearts, holding an axe grants Speed I and Strength II, and right-clicking a Piglin opens a custom bartering menu. Piglins remain neutral.
